drop: Drop an HWP or HWPX file here to convert it to PDF
privacy: Your document stays in this browser. No uploads or remote document resources.
invalid: Choose a readable HWP 5 or HWPX document. The file may be damaged or use an unsupported format.
failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This document contains unsupported or missing content. Save a self-contained copy in Hangul and try again.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page, close other tabs, or try another current browser.
fidelity: The PDF contains page images at 150 DPI. Text cannot be selected or searched, and OCR is not added. Pages keep the size and order reported by the renderer.
limitations: Fonts are substituted with bundled Korean fonts. Complex tables, equations, text boxes, headers, and pagination may differ from Hangul. Scripts and linked resources are not loaded; digital signatures are not preserved or verified.
protected: Password-protected or rights-managed documents cannot be converted. Save an unencrypted copy in Hangul and try again.
layoutNotice: This is an image-based PDF with substituted fonts. Check every page before downloading, especially official forms and complex layouts.
engineDownload: The first conversion downloads the rendering engines and Korean fonts. Your browser may cache them; your document is never uploaded.
distribution: Distribution-only HWP documents cannot be converted. Use the original unrestricted document.
legacy: HWP 3 and earlier versions are not supported. Save the document as HWP 5 or HWPX in Hangul.
browserUnsupported: This browser cannot run the document renderer. Try a current browser on another device.
